episodes.title: Day One
episodes.summary: Hurricane Katrina makes landfall in New Orleans. At Memorial Hospital, the doctors, nurses, and staff tend to patients and brace for the storm.

episodes.title: Day Two
episodes.summary: The staff and patients think they've made it through the worst—except the waters aren't receding. Reports of a new crisis circulate.

episodes.title: Day Three
episodes.summary: As the city floods, the hospital loses power. Mulderick and the staff attempt to cope with the terrible conditions and prepare for an evacuation.

episodes.title: Day Four
episodes.summary: Conditions continue to worsen. Mulderick, Pou, and more staff grapple with how to best help their patients—and how that help will be prioritized.

episodes.title: Day Five
episodes.summary: With pressures mounting to abandon the hospital, the staff is forced to make challenging decisions.

episodes.title: 45 Dead
episodes.summary: State investigators begin to explore what happened to the 45 people found dead at Memorial in the aftermath of the hurricane.

episodes.title: Nobody Knows the Trouble I've Seen
episodes.summary: New evidence comes to light as Schafer and Rider dig deeper into their investigation of the deaths at Memorial.

episodes.title: The Reckoning
episodes.summary: Series finale. Pou fights to defend herself. Schafer and Rider push their case forward.
